The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing coordination, and onboarding IT professionals while ensuring timely hiring and a positive candidate experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1. IT Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and technical positions.
* Understand hiring requirements from technical managers and department heads.

* Coordinate technical interviews with hiring managers and development teams.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT candidates.

**2. Recruitment Coordination**

* Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates and interview panels.
* Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Negotiate salary expectations and coordinate offer releases.
* Follow up on offer acceptance, joining dates, and candidate availability.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.

**3. HR Operations & Onboarding**

* Coordinate documentation and background verification for new employees.
* Manage joining formalities and employee onboarding.
* Maintain employee records and recruitment documentation.
* Support HR activities, employee engagement, and other administrative tasks as required.

**4. Recruitment Reporting**

* Track recruitment metrics, including time-to-hire, sourcing channels, interview-to-selection ratio, and offer acceptance rate.
* Prepare weekly recruitment reports.
* Maintain an updated database of candidates and recruitment activities.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT recruitment or technical talent acquisition.
* Good understanding of IT job roles, technical skills, and recruitment terminology.
* Experience using job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and meet hiring deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment tracking systems.

Preferred Skills

* Experience recruiting for software development and technology companies.
* Familiarity with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems).
* Knowledge of IT technologies such as Java, Python, .NET, SQL, React, Angular, and cloud platforms.
* Ability to build candidate networks and maintain long-term talent pipelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful hires per month.
* Average time-to-fill vacancies.
* Quality of candidates shortlisted.
* Interview attendance and offer acceptance rates.
* Candidate experience and hiring manager satisfaction.
* Accuracy of recruitment records and reporting.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated HR professional with strong sourcing skills, an understanding of technical recruitment, excellent communication abilities, and the ability to manage multiple hiring requirements efficiently.

title: WalkMe Process Developer
description:
WalkMe Process Developer – Digital Adoption  
  
Role Purpose  
Centrica is looking for an experienced WalkMe Process Developer to support the design, development and continuous improvement of digital adoption solutions across enterprise applications and business processes.  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, process owners, product teams, change teams and technology specialists to understand user journeys, identify areas of friction and develop effective WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) solutions that improve user experience, process compliance, productivity and adoption.  
The WalkMe Process Developer will translate business processes and user requirements into intuitive in application guidance, automation and contextual support, helping users complete activities correctly and efficiently while reducing dependency on traditional training and manual support.  
  
The role requires a combination of WalkMe development, process analysis, user experience thinking, testing, analytics and stakeholder management capability.  
  
  
  
Certifications – Desirable  
Relevant certifications would be advantageous, particularly:  
  
. WalkMe Digital Adoption Technical Certification  
. WalkMe Builder / Developer certifications  
. WalkMe Project Management or Solution Architecture certifications  
. Change Management certification  
. Lean / Process Improvement certification  
  
Certification should complement, rather than replace, strong hands on WalkMe development experience.  
Key Competencies  
WalkMe DevelopmentAble to independently design, build, test and maintain high quality WalkMe solutions.  
Process ThinkingUnderstands the underlying business process rather than simply adding guidance to application screens.  
User Centred DesignDesigns digital adoption experiences around what users need to successfully complete their work.  
Analytical ThinkingUses adoption and behavioural data to identify problems and measure whether solutions are effective.  
Problem SolvingAble to troubleshoot complex WalkMe behaviour and application interaction issues.  
Stakeholder ManagementComfortable working directly with business process owners, application teams and transformation stakeholders.  
Continuous ImprovementUses analytics, feedback and changing business requirements to continually improve digital experiences.  
Expected Outcomes  
The WalkMe Process Developer will help Centrica to:  
  
. Improve adoption of enterprise applications and new technology.  
. Simplify complex user journeys.  
. Reduce process errors and rework.  
. Improve process compliance.  
. Increase employee productivity.  
. Reduce dependency on traditional training and support.  
. Accelerate adoption following technology releases and business process changes.  
. Provide contextual support directly within enterprise applications.  
. Generate measurable insight into user behaviour and adoption.  
. Identify opportunities for further process simplification and automation.  
. Improve the overall digital employee experience.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

1. WalkMe Solution Development  
  
. Design, configure, develop and maintain digital adoption solutions using WalkMe.  
. Build WalkMe components including: Smart Walk Thrus SmartTips Launchers ShoutOuts Resources Surveys Onboarding Tasks Menus and contextual guidance  
. Configure WalkMe Rules and Conditions to deliver relevant guidance based on user context.  
. Develop solutions that simplify complex business processes and improve user productivity.  
. Ensure WalkMe content is intuitive, maintainable and aligned with agreed user experience standards.  
. Optimise existing WalkMe solutions based on user feedback and analytics.  
  
2. Process Analysis & Improvement  
  
. Engage with process owners and business stakeholders to understand current business processes and user journeys.  
. Analyse existing processes to identify: User pain points Repetitive activities Process errors Training gaps Compliance issues Navigation challenges Opportunities for automation  
. Translate process requirements into effective digital adoption solutions.  
. Challenge unnecessary process complexity and recommend opportunities for simplification.  
. Support broader process improvement initiatives across Centrica.  
  
3. Digital Adoption & User Experience  
  
. Design WalkMe experiences that help users adopt new applications, functionality and business processes.  
. Develop contextual, in application guidance rather than relying solely on traditional training materials.  
. Ensure guidance is presented to the right user, at the right point in the process.  
. Reduce user effort and improve completion rates for key business processes.  
. Design effective onboarding journeys for new systems and functionality.  
. Work with UX, Product and Change teams to ensure a consistent employee/user experience.  
  
4. Application & Process Onboarding  
  
. Support onboarding of enterprise applications and business processes onto the WalkMe platform.  
. Assess candidate processes for suitability for digital adoption.  
. Understand application behaviour, workflows and user personas.  
. Define the appropriate WalkMe approach for each application/process.  
. Configure and validate WalkMe implementation across development, test and production environments.  
. Support deployment and release of new WalkMe content.  
  
5. WalkMe Analytics & Insights  
  
. Use WalkMe Analytics / Insights to understand user behaviour and adoption.  
. Monitor: Walk Thru usage Process completion Drop off points User engagement Feature adoption Error/failure patterns  
. Analyse user journeys to identify areas where additional guidance or process improvement is required.  
. Establish measurable adoption and success criteria.  
. Provide stakeholders with insights on adoption, usage and business outcomes.  
. Use data to continuously improve WalkMe solutions.  
  
6. WalkMe Editor & Technical Configuration  
  
. Develop solutions using the WalkMe Editor.  
. Configure element selection and page recognition.  
. Develop robust rules and segmentation.  
. Troubleshoot issues caused by dynamic web page behaviour or application changes.  
. Ensure WalkMe content remains resilient when underlying applications are updated.  
. Apply appropriate technical standards for maintainability and performance.  
. Work with application development teams where technical support is required.  
  
7. JavaScript / CSS / Web Technologies  
Where standard WalkMe functionality requires extension:  
  
. Use JavaScript to support advanced WalkMe behaviour.  
. Apply HTML/CSS knowledge to customise presentation and user experience.  
. Understand DOM structures and web application behaviour.  
. Troubleshoot element selection and application compatibility issues.  
. Develop technical solutions without unnecessarily increasing implementation complexity.  
  
8. Testing & Quality Assurance  
  
. Develop and execute test scenarios for WalkMe solutions.  
. Validate content across relevant user personas, applications, browsers and environments.  
. Perform regression testing following application changes.  
. Ensure WalkMe content does not negatively affect underlying application functionality.  
. Validate segmentation and conditional logic.  
. Resolve defects prior to production deployment.  
. Maintain appropriate quality and release controls.  
  
9. Stakeholder Engagement  
Work closely with:  
  
. Business Process Owners  
. Digital Adoption teams  
. Product Owners  
. Business Analysts  
. Change & Transformation teams  
. Learning & Development  
. UX teams  
. Application teams  
. Software Engineers  
. Service Management  
. Security  
. Business users  
  
Facilitate workshops to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and gather feedback.  
Translate technical WalkMe capabilities into understandable business outcomes for non technical stakeholders.  
10. Change & Transformation Support  
  
. Support major technology and business transformation initiatives through digital adoption.  
. Develop WalkMe content to support new system releases and process changes.  
. Work with Change teams to understand user impact assessments.  
. Provide targeted guidance for affected user groups.  
. Support phased deployments and adoption campaigns.  
. Reduce reliance on classroom training, lengthy manuals and repetitive support activity where contextual guidance provides a better user experience.  
  
11. Governance & Standards  
  
. Follow agreed Centrica digital adoption standards and governance.  
. Maintain reusable WalkMe design patterns and templates.  
. Ensure appropriate naming, documentation and version control standards.  
. Maintain clear ownership of WalkMe content.  
. Establish appropriate review and approval processes.  
. Ensure obsolete guidance is retired when applications or processes change.  
. Contribute to development of WalkMe best practices across the organisation.  
  
12. Security, Privacy & Accessibility  
  
. Ensure WalkMe solutions comply with Centrica security and data protection requirements.  
. Avoid exposing sensitive information through WalkMe content.  
. Apply appropriate user segmentation and access considerations.  
. Ensure digital adoption content meets relevant accessibility requirements.  
. Work with Security and application teams where solutions interact with sensitive processes or data.  
  
13. Continuous Improvement  
  
. Continuously evaluate WalkMe solutions and identify opportunities for optimisation.  
. Use analytics, user feedback and support data to prioritise improvements.  
. Identify opportunities to replace manual guidance with contextual digital assistance.  
. Promote reusable solutions and standards.  
. Stay current with new WalkMe capabilities and digital adoption best practices.  
. Recommend new platform capabilities that could improve employee experience or operational efficiency.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Mandatory Skills & Experience  
The successful candidate should have hands on experience with:  
  
. WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform  
. WalkMe Editor  
. Smart Walk Thrus  
. SmartTips  
. Launchers  
. ShoutOuts  
. WalkMe Rules / Conditions  
. User segmentation  
. WalkMe Analytics / Insights  
. Digital adoption solution design  
. Business process analysis  
. User journey analysis  
. Requirements gathering  
. Testing and troubleshooting  
  
The candidate should also demonstrate:  
  
. Experience translating business processes into digital adoption solutions.  
. Strong process analysis and problem solving capability.  
. Experience working directly with business stakeholders.  
. Understanding of user experience and usability principles.  
. Ability to analyse user behaviour and adoption data.  
. Strong documentation and communication skills.  
. Experience working within enterprise technology environments.  
  
Desirable Technical Skills  
Experience with the following would be advantageous:  
  
. JavaScript  
. HTML  
. CSS  
. DOM / browser developer tools  
. APIs and web applications  
. Microsoft 365  
. Dynamics 365  
. Salesforce  
. ServiceNow  
. SAP  
. Workday  
. Power Platform  
. Power BI  
. Microsoft Copilot  
  
Experience implementing WalkMe across one or more large enterprise applications would be particularly valuable.  
Desirable Digital Adoption Experience  
  
. WalkMe implementation across large user populations.  
. Enterprise Digital Adoption Platform programmes.  
. Application onboarding and adoption.  
. User behaviour analytics.  
. Change management.  
. Employee experience improvement.  
. Learning/training transformation.  
. Process optimisation.  
. Digital transformation programmes.  
  
Candidate Profile  
The ideal candidate is not simply a WalkMe content builder.  
The strongest candidate should be able to take a business process such as:  
“Users are struggling to complete this process correctly and are generating high volumes of support requests.”  
and work through:  
Process understanding user journey analysis pain point identification WalkMe solution design development testing deployment adoption measurement continuous improvement.  
The candidate should therefore combine:  
WalkMe Development + Process Analysis + Digital Adoption + UX Thinking + Analytics + Stakeholder Management  
with sufficient technical capability to troubleshoot complex enterprise applications.  
Candidates with backgrounds such as WalkMe Developer, WalkMe Builder, Digital Adoption Developer, DAP Consultant, Digital Adoption Analyst or Process Improvement Developer would be particularly relevant.

description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 398503
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Industry Consulting Snr. Consultant to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description – nCino Developer / Salesforce Developer
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced nCino Developer with strong Salesforce expertise and 8+ years of IT experience in designing, developing, configuring, customizing, and supporting enterprise banking applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with nCino Banking Cloud and Salesforce, with strong knowledge of lending, onboarding, workflow automation, customer lifecycle, servicing, and banking processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for developing scalable and secure nCino/Salesforce solutions, integrating the platform with enterprise applications, and working closely with business and technical teams to deliver banking solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, develop, configure, customize, and maintain nCino Banking Cloud and Salesforce solutions based on business requirements.
* Develop and enhance functionality across commercial lending, loan origination, credit processes, customer onboarding, servicing, workflow, and case management.
* Configure nCino objects, workflows, approval processes, product configuration, lending processes, and business rules.
* Develop custom Salesforce components using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Flows, Triggers, and other Salesforce capabilities.
* Build reusable components, automation, workflows, APIs, and integrations within the nCino/Salesforce ecosystem.
* Integrate nCino/Salesforce with core banking systems, credit platforms, document management systems, third-party applications, and external services using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Solution Architects, QA teams, and business stakeholders to translate banking requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Participate in solution design, technical architecture reviews, code reviews, performance optimization, and implementation planning.
* Support Agile delivery through sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and release activities.
* Troubleshoot nCino/Salesforce issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Ensure compliance with Salesforce/nCino best practices, security standards, data access controls, and enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to development teams.
* Support CI/CD, deployment, release management, production support, and continuous platform optimization.

Required Skills
  

* 8+ years of overall IT experience, with strong hands-on experience in Salesforce/nCino development.
* 3+ years of hands-on nCino experience preferred.
* Strong experience with nCino Banking Cloud and Salesforce CRM.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flows, Triggers, Validation Rules, and Approval Processes.
* Strong understanding of nCino lending and banking capabilities, including loan origination, credit processes, onboarding, servicing, and workflow.
* Experience with Salesforce data model, security model, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, roles, and access controls.
* Experience integrating Salesforce/nCino with external applications using REST APIs, SOAP, middleware, and event-driven integration.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data migration, integration patterns, and application architecture.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience in Banking / Financial Services, particularly commercial lending or corporate banking.
* Experience with nCino Loan Origination System, Customer Engagement, Deposit Account Opening, or Portfolio Management.
* Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Platform App Builder, or Salesforce Administrator.
* nCino certifications are highly preferred.
* Experience with cloud platforms and enterprise middleware technologies.
* Experience with automated testing, monitoring, production support, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.

Education
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Key Competencies
  

* Strong nCino Salesforce technical expertise
* Banking and lending domain knowledge
* Salesforce development and configuration
* Integration and API development
* Solution design and technical architecture
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Agile delivery experience
* Stakeholder communication and collaboration
* Mentoring and technical leadership
* Customer-focused mindset
* Ability to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable banking solutions

Cyber

Deloitte Cyber helps organizations address complex cybersecurity challenges and opportunities. Join our team to help clients strengthen application security, manage risk, and support secure transformation across SAP environments.

Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. * Contribute subject matter knowledge across SAP application security and controls domains
* Identify potential engagement risks and escalate them to leadership proactively
* Support project planning, execution, and deliverable quality across engagements
* Participate in proposal development efforts

About the job

**Aydya | Full-stack AI Filmmaking Studio**

**Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid / Remote flexibility)**

**Experience: 3–6 years**

**Employment: Full-time**

**About Aydya**

Aydya is a full-stack AI filmmaking studio combining creative storytelling, strategy and AI-powered production to create compelling visual content for brands and businesses.

We’re building a nationwide network of independent Growth Partners to expand our market reach and drive business growth.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on professional to build, manage and scale Aydya’s Growth Partner Network from the ground up.

You’ll own the entire partner lifecycle — from recruitment and onboarding to engagement, performance and revenue generation.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building systems, developing relationships and driving measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Build & Scale the Partner Network

\* Develop and execute the national partner acquisition strategy.

\* Identify and recruit consultants, agency owners and business development professionals across India.

\* Establish partner qualification, onboarding and engagement processes.

2. Activate & Manage Partners

\* Equip partners with sales materials, training and ongoing support.

\* Build strong relationships and drive consistent partner engagement.

description:
HR Recruiter manages the full-cycle recruitment process. They partner with hiring managers to define staffing needs, write job descriptions, source candidates across multiple platforms, conduct interviews, and guide top talent through the offer, negotiation, and onboarding stages.

* **Screening & Interviewing:** Review resumes, conduct initial phone/video screenings, and evaluate candidates for both skill and cultural fit.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with department heads to understand their hiring criteria and advise them on salary benchmarks and market trends.
* **Offer Management:** Extend job offers, facilitate compensation negotiations, and handle initial onboarding coordination.
* **Data Management:** Track recruitment metrics (such as time-to-fill) and maintain accurate candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Proven experience as an HR Recruiter, Talent Acquisition Specialist, or in a similar recruitment-focused role.
